player_prompt.intro:
Ove uli Muthandi {player_id} mu **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Leta ovingui lyo ngendi **[macro  micro]** (nomero mbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = mini-tabuleiro wapi ove uli muthandi
• *micro* = ku quadrado wapi munda mini-tabuleiro
Exemplo `[7 8]` ➜ koma ovingui lyo munda mini-tabuleiro 7, quadrado 8, no
kuforça oponente lyo muthandi munda mini-tabuleiro 8 ina.

Ove uli `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Oku imba ku lingiwa lolonduko 0-8 kuenda [macro micro].
invalid_move.out_of_range: O mayendo omanene okwa kala kati ya 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Ocimunga caco ale okalivulu kaco, ka ci pondola oku ku kuatisa.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Pole, lomue o kasi vohondo yaco.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Ocimunga comanu vaco, ci ka kuatavo onepa koku yekela olombongo viavo.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Momo omapalo yaco ya siata oku lingiwa lomanu valua.

game_action.played: Muthandi {player_id} muthandi munda mini-tabuleiro {macro_idx}, kela {micro_idx} (linha {row}, coluna {col}). Muthandi {opponent_id} ana kuwa muthandi munda {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Mukwiyu {player_id} usena Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
outcome.draw: Momo omapalo yaco ya kala ndu okuti, ka va kuatele omunu ukuavo o yi yula.
